lessons_applied: Actual input feature and corresponding target edge or grouping must both have a stated role.
Do not alter semantic fill, original cut boundaries, labels, pips or hidden-visibility geometry.
Two complete target finals are necessary; same nonpreset wrong letter twice remains a miss.
Independent review, human readability and a unique correct mathematical answer remain separate from model outcomes.
